The '''Magra Monad''' was a gigantic residential building found in the [[Yaam Sector]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], at the intersection of [[Bellus Boulevard]] and [[Zyra Street]]. Standing a thousand stories tall, the Magra [[Monad/Legends|Monad]] was a self-contained arcology that provided everything its tenants needed to exist. The only thing that the Magra Monad did not generate itself was [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], although it was rumored that many residents wanted to generate their own.
